verdict.rationale: Reclaim publishes a help article on how its pricing and plans work, and it states that the Lite tier is free for any single user with essential smart time-blocking features. That shows some tier information is public before talking to sales. However, the evidence gives no per-seat dollar amounts for paid tiers and no breakdown of what each tier includes. Missing for 10: published per-seat prices for paid tiers, per-tier feature inclusions and limits, evidence that pricing is self-serve without contacting sales, independent corroboration.
